entities.name: Spindlewight
entities.description: Leader of the beasties on Duskmourn and the first to befriend Survivors, who discovered his people's purpose of protecting them.

entities.name: Beasties
entities.description: Creatures of the House who came to protect survivors, called keep-alives.

entities.name: The House
entities.description: The dangerous House that the beasties and survivors inhabit.

entities.name: Cellarspawn
entities.description: Horror from which Spindlewight defended the survivors.

events.summary: Spindlewight finds three survivors in a ruined library and defends them from a cellarspawn; the dying parent entrusts him with the children.
events.quote: In a ruined library, he discovered three survivors

events.summary: Spindlewight learns his people's purpose is to protect survivors and brings it back to the beasties.
events.quote: This encounter revealed his people's purpose: to protect and cherish the survivors

events.summary: A keep-alive flees when Spindlewight's mask falls; he steps down from leadership.
Spindlewight dies, and only his mask is returned by the survivor.
events.quote: with only Spindlewight's mask returned by the survivor
